messages:
alex: Heads up — invoice preview spike for tenant `xyz_corp` around 12:03 UTC, preview shows +2x tokens compared to last 24h
sara: seeing that too. preview vs final diverging. console shows a narrow spike on the preview chart :grimacing:
jamal: any sample events we can inspect? request_id or offsets?
alex: pasted a couple of raw events below, same request_id but different watermark values:
```
{request_id: 'r-7a9f', tenant: 'xyz_corp', watermark: 1680012300, partition: 4, offset: 123457}
{request_id: 'r-7a9f', tenant: 'xyz_corp', watermark: 1680011200, partition: 4, offset: 123458}
```
sara: that looks like duplicate processing with older watermark replayed — maybe shadow consumer processed a stale message set?
metering-bot: alert: invoice-preview-surge tenant=xyz_corp delta_tokens=+1180 preview_window=10m
maria: we rolled out the watermark-change canary last night (eng-platform -> consumer watermark handling). Could be related.
jamal: quick check: kafka offsets for partition 4 show a small overlap after a brief rebalance. consumer B acked but then reprocessed due to stale commit visibility.
alex: query I ran:
```sql
SELECT request_id, watermark, partition, offset, ts FROM metering.events WHERE tenant='xyz_corp' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 40;
```
sara: results match alex's sample. duplicates with decreasing watermark. this will double-count tokens on preview pipeline which doesn't dedupe.
jamal: detection: shadow replica sometimes republishes events to preview topic during failover. root cause likely consumer group rebalance + lagged checkpoint.
maria: mitigation ideas: 1) short-term: add aggregator-side dedupe window using (request_id, watermark) as key 2) long-term: make replica publish idempotent with monotonic event ids
alex: I can hack quick filter: ignore events where watermark < last_seen_watermark for that request_id. risky but small blast radius for preview-only path.
sara: prefer aggregator dedupe with TTL (24h) so we don't touch final pipeline logic.
jamal: agreed. implementing a small in-memory LRU with persistent backing per partition should work for now. PR incoming.
maria: UX ask: add a toggle in Console invoice-preview to show 'shadow vs primary' lineage so PMs can see where the token came from. filing a product ticket.
engineer-oncall: I'm on call this afternoon — if you need a live Kafka inspect or to run a one-off scrub, ping me and I'll join the call.
alex: created ticket INF-1456 for the dedupe hotfix and scrubbing job, assigning to eng-platform. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7890 (draft)
sara: will review the PR. also adding a dashboard alert for "preview_count / final_count > 1.25" to catch regressions earlier.
jamal: one more note: we should emit a metric 'watermark_entropy' per consumer to catch drift preemptively.
maria: added UI request INF-1459 for preview lineage toggle, linking INF-1456.
alex: thanks everyone. next steps: jamal lands dedupe, alex coordinates scrub with engineer-oncall, sara wires alert, maria owns UX ticket.
sara: ping when PR is ready for quick review :thumbsup:
engineer-oncall: noted. I'll stand by for the scrub job window (prefer maintenance slot tonight).
alex: scheduling scrub at 22:00 UTC, will post runbook.
sara: nice. closing loop here for now.
note: Generated Slack thread about preview/invoice spike due to watermark skew and duplicate processing.
